notes: FM9 support: the tone match, the cab choice, Recall, song presets, recording your DI and Play along now work on the FM9 (firmware 12.00); its extra blocks and preset / scene names are not available yet. A Cab block that kept your own preset's panning is now always centred; the cab measurement repeats a cab that comes back too loud more quietly instead of stopping, and resumes after a recall.
